stemMd: What is the period of y = sin(3x)?
explanationMd: Sine repeats when its argument increases by 2π. Therefore 3T = 2π, giving T = 2π/3. Increasing the input frequency shortens the period.

distractorRationale.c: This is the period before the input is multiplied by three.
distractorRationale.a: This stretches the period instead of compressing it.
distractorRationale.b: This is half the required full cycle.
distractorRationale.d: The input multiplier itself is not the period.
